name: tests-75pct-go-geom-transactional-geometry-mutation-journals
instr:
Add mutation subscriptions and batches for Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, MultiPolygon, and GeometryCollection.

Deliver Point and LineString coordinate replacements synchronously as one MutationCoordinates record. Polygon.Push emits one MutationTopology record identifying the receiver and appended ring index. MultiPoint appends have distinct member paths, including empty members. Collection SRID changes report children in order, then the parent. Closing a subscription stops its delivery independently.

Batches defer records until commit, preserve operation order, and use one nonzero BatchID followed by one MutationBatchCommitted record. Rollback restores prior values and emits only MutationBatchRolledBack. Nested transforms wait for outer completion. A rollback after commit returns an error without changing geometry or records.

Veto returns an error and restores LineString coordinates, Polygon coordinates/ends, and MultiPolygon coordinates/endss/member count; LineString veto uses *MutationRejectedError. Preserve empty Point rollback, repeated MultiPoint/MultiLineString ends, empty MultiPolygon members and cumulative Polygon ends. Wrong-stride LineString.SetCoords returns nil and an error without mutation or publication; layout-mismatched Polygon/MultiLineString pushes publish nothing.

TransformInPlaceWithMutations visits polygon coordinates in flat order and heterogeneous collection coordinates in one batch. Callback errors retain their cause, res
